mapper.select: SELECT id, normalized_item_name, display_item_name, brand, unit, category, lowest_price, source, source_url, observed_at, search_confidence FROM FEED_PRICE_REFERENCE WHERE (category IS NULL OR category = #{category}) AND REPLACE(LOWER(unit), ' ', '') = #{normalizedUnit} AND ( normalized_item_name = #{normalizedItemName} OR normalized_item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{normalizedItemName}, '%') OR #{normalizedItemName} LIKE CONCAT('%', normalized_item_name, '%') ) AND ( brand = '' OR #{normalizedBrand} = '' OR REPLACE(LOWER(brand), ' ', '') = #{normalizedBrand} ) ORDER BY normalized_item_name = #{normalizedItemName} DESC, REPLACE(LOWER(brand), ' ', '') = #{normalizedBrand} DESC, search_confidence DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FEED_PRICE_REFERENCE (normalized_item_name, display_item_name, brand, unit, category, lowest_price, source, source_url, observed_at, expires_at, search_confidence) VALUES (#{normalizedItemName}, #{displayItemName}, #{brand}, #{unit}, #{category}, #{lowestPrice}, #{source}, #{sourceUrl}, #{observedAt}, NULL, #{searchConfidence}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_item_name = VALUES(display_item_name), category = VALUES(category), lowest_price = VALUES(lowest_price), source = VALUES(source), source_url = VALUES(source_url), observed_at = VALUES(observed_at), expires_at = NULL, search_confidence = VALUES(search_confidence)
